verdict: Every interactive surface I exercised (Try box with 10 of my own lines, struck-word toggles, hero examples, four feed previews, voice, reply, Studio approval, pricing toggle, FAQ, final input, and the signup sheet in start/plan/sign-in/error/done states) behaved like a shipped product, with honest preview copy, correct focus handling, 0 CLS, no console errors and a finished reduced-motion layout. What is left is small P2 polish in edge cases, none of it visible in the first five seconds of any section.

issues.where: Try box, a 300-character line ending '...not even me to be honest with you all here'
issues.problem: Cutting 'to be honest with you all' leaves an orphaned tail: the posted card reads '...at all, not even me here'. The demo shows a slightly broken sentence as the sharpened result.
issues.fix: When a cut phrase is followed only by a trailing filler adverb (here/now/too) at the end of the line, cut that word with it, or do not cut the phrase and list it as 'your call'.

issues.where: Try box, 'Very excited to share that basically 3 things changed my writing...'
issues.problem: The note says: Left 'basically' in: it says nearly, not exactly. Here 'basically' in front of an exact count is filler, so the explanation is untrue and the result opens on 'Basically 3 things'.
issues.fix: Treat 'basically' directly before a number or at the start of the resulting line as fluff (cut it), or make it a dotted 'your call' word instead of asserting a reason.

issues.problem: With a one-line example there is an empty band of roughly 40 px between the draft line and the 'Tap a struck word to put it back' hint, so the hint looks detached from the words it refers to.
issues.fix: Keep the reserved height (for CLS) but anchor the hint directly under the last text line and let the spare space fall below the hint, above the divider.

issues.where: 390: starter chips (Wordy, Announcement...), hero example chips (36 px tall), nav Sign in (65x37)
issues.problem: These sit under the 44 px comfortable minimum, while the smaller controls (struck words, Try it, Replay) already have extended 44-52 px hit areas. The chips are the inconsistent ones.
issues.fix: Give .starters buttons, the hero example buttons and .signin the same ::after hit-area extension to 44 px tall; no visual change.

issues.problem: Page is 8107 px tall at 360: 10.96 screens on a 360x740 viewport (10.1 on 360x800), so on short phones it is above the 10.5 target. 390x844 is 9.98, within budget.
issues.fix: Trim about 340 px at 360 only: reduce the Day card phone crop height and the bento card vertical padding by 4-6 px each at max-width 374 px.
